sources.title: gemma-2-9b-it: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview gemma-2-9b-it is a 9-billion-parameter instruction-tuned language model from google, built on the same research and technology as Google's Gemini models. The model operates as a decoder-only transformer trained on 8 trillion tokens drawn from diverse sources including web documents, code, and mathematical text. sources.title: gemma-2-9b-it-DPO Model Card
sources.snippet: This model was trained under the same setup as gemma-2-9b-it-SimPO, with the DPO objective. SimPO (Simple Preference Optimization) is an offline preference optimization algorithm designed to enhance the training of large language models (LLMs) with preference optimization datasets.
